handle_non_streaming_request: handle a non-streaming A2A request to AgentCore by sending a signed JSON-RPC envelope and returning the response
handle_streaming_request: handle a streaming A2A request to AgentCore by sending a signed JSON-RPC envelope and yielding SSE events or JSON fallback
build_signed_request_envelope: build a signed JSON-RPC request envelope for Bedrock AgentCore A2A message/send endpoint
parse_sse_events: parse server-sent events from an AgentCore streaming response and yield individual events
review_BedrockAgentCoreA2AHandler: review the BedrockAgentCoreA2AHandler class and its non-streaming and streaming request handling methods
